command:
Task: Implement L R peak meter rendering
Phase: G
Description: Implement Source/GUI/MeterComponent.cpp only, matching Source/GUI/MeterComponent.h. Render L/R peak and RMS LED-style bars on the message thread via a capped juce::Timer. Pull or snapshot levels that the processor publishes lock-free; never call into the audio thread; never allocate on an audio path.

STRICT FILE SCOPE: Create or modify ONLY Source/GUI/MeterComponent.cpp.

Before editing, inspect:
- Source/GUI/MeterComponent.h
- Source/PluginProcessor.h (meter level fields / atomics)
- Source/GUI/SpectrumVisualizer.cpp (Timer paint pattern for consistency)

Implementation requirements:
- Include MeterComponent.h and implement all declared methods
- timerCallback at the header's 30-60 Hz cap snapshots L/R peak and RMS and calls repaint on the message thread only
- paint() draws separate L and R vertical (or project-consistent) LED/bar meters for peak and RMS with sensible dB scaling and clamp
- Decay/hold may run on the message thread only
- No mutex-based audio-to-UI transfer; use header atomics/lock-free levels only
- Pre-size any path/geometry work outside the audio thread

Do not modify the header, SpectrumVisualizer, or processor/editor in this task.

backend_executions.stdout:
I have completed Phase G Task G.4 (L/R Peak & RMS Meter Rendering).

### Summary of Changes
- Implemented [Source/GUI/MeterComponent.cpp](file:///home/mike/dev/mike/music/plugins/aural-maximizer-pro/Source/GUI/MeterComponent.cpp) strictly matching [Source/GUI/MeterComponent.h](file:///home/mike/dev/mike/music/plugins/aural-maximizer-pro/Source/GUI/MeterComponent.h).
- **Lock-Free Level Transfer**: `setLevels`, `pushLevels`, and getter methods load/store atomic levels using `std::memory_order_relaxed` without any mutexes or memory allocations.
- **Timer Refresh & Decay**: `timerCallback` runs on the message thread at `updateRateHz` (60 Hz cap), snapshots atomic levels, applies exponential decay, and triggers `repaint()`.
- **LED-Style Rendering**: `paint()` renders distinct Left and Right vertical LED segment bars for peak and RMS levels with logarithmic dB scaling (`-60 dB` to `0 dB`), gradient fills, segment dividers, and peak hold ticks matching `CustomLookAndFeel` colors.
- **Verification**: Formatted and verified using `clang-format --dry-run --Werror`. Strictly modified only `Source/GUI/MeterComponent.cpp`.
